observations.observation: The query requested entity home, but retrieval included work and the fixed consumer returned Paris instead of expected Berlin; entity filtering is disabled.
The as-of date 2026-01-05 should select Berlin, but retrieval returned current Paris; time-aware filtering is disabled.
A future-valid record starting 2026-01-10 was returned for as-of 2026-01-05, producing Paris instead of Berlin.
The primary-entity query returned the newest project distractors and Bath instead of Berlin; entity filtering is disabled.

hypothesis: Enabling entity and as-of-date filtering will prevent cross-entity distractors and exclude records outside the requested validity interval, improving complete-scenario task success without changing write admission or hard-constraint behavior.
predicted_effect: Entity-grounding and distractor retrieval should return the requested entity, while historical-address and future-move should select the record valid at the requested as-of date. Retrieval noise and stale-fact errors should decrease.
